questions.stem: How does the induced fit model differ from the lock and key model?

options.text: The induced fit model says enzymes are not specific to their substrates
In the induced fit model, the active site changes shape slightly when the substrate binds
The induced fit model does not involve an active site
In the induced fit model, the substrate changes shape permanently

questions.explanation: In the induced fit model, the active site is not a perfect fit for the substrate initially. When the substrate binds, the active site changes shape slightly to fit more closely around it, like a glove moulding to a hand.
